dishes.name: Hollandse Nieuwe herring
dishes.desc: Young herring eaten raw with chopped onions and pickles, caught in early summer. Scheveningen harbour is the classic place to taste it.

dishes.name: Kibbeling
dishes.desc: Chunks of battered, deep-fried white fish with garlic sauce. A Scheveningen harbour snack eaten from a paper tray.

dishes.name: Haagse hopjes
dishes.desc: Coffee-caramel hard sweets named after a count of the Hague. Created in the city in the 18th century.

dishes.name: Haagse bluf
dishes.desc: Light dessert of whipped egg white, sugar and berry juice. A traditional Hague pudding.

dishes.name: Soto ayam
dishes.desc: Indonesian chicken soup with rice noodles and egg. Den Haag has a large Indo-Dutch community and many specialist eateries.
